learner_task: Explain why one-hot cross-entropy reduces to negative log probability for the correct class, including its domain and what it does not guarantee.

source_locations.title: 交叉熵：怎样衡量预测误差
source_locations.heading: 为什么简化成了 -log(p)？

comprehension_question: If the correct class probability falls from 0.9 to 0.1, does the loss become smaller or larger, and why?
prohibited_claims: Minimizing cross-entropy guarantees a true answer.
figure_format_limitations: If the supplied complete artifact flattens a diagram, state the limitation rather than inventing its visual relationship.
